name: Yield Ahead
spec: yellow diamond with a small red-and-white YIELD triangle symbol and a black upward arrow
meaning: A yield sign is ahead; be ready to slow or stop.

snippets.back: STOP AHEAD and YIELD AHEAD signs warn that a STOP sign or a YIELD sign is coming up.

Yellow warnings preview wet slipperiness, merging traffic, divided-highway shifts, two-way traffic, ending lanes, signals ahead, crossings, added lanes, crossroads, stop or yield ahead, curves, windings.
Some warning signs announce a control device before you reach it, such as Stop Ahead, Yield Ahead and Signal Ahead.
Roundabout Ahead, Stop Ahead and Yield Ahead signs warn that a roundabout, a stop sign or a yield sign is coming up.
Yield Ahead warns that a yield sign is approaching.
Stop Ahead, Yield Ahead, and Signal Ahead signs each warn that the named control is coming: slow down and stand ready to stop.
STOP AHEAD and YIELD AHEAD signs only warn that a control is coming; the stop or yield itself happens at the STOP or YIELD sign further on.

result.summary: Meaning is supported: snippets say Yield Ahead warns a yield sign is approaching and to slow/stand ready to stop. No snippet describes a yellow diamond with YIELD triangle and arrow, so spec is not covered.
